name: Geometry Dash Timing Analyzer
description: osu!-style timing analyzer for the level editor: song waveform, BPM and tempo-change detection, editable timing points, .osu import / export, metronome, guidelines and local songs.

metronome-ticks.name: Metronome ticks
metronome-ticks.description: 1/1 = a click on every beat. 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 = also quieter clicks between the beats.

metronome-accent.name: First beat of a bar volume (%)
metronome-accent.description: How loud the first beat of every bar is compared to the other beats.

metronome-offset.name: Metronome offset (ms)
metronome-offset.description: Plays the clicks earlier (positive) or later (negative) to compensate for audio latency.

show-object-beat.name: Show beat of selected object
show-object-beat.description: In the editor, shows at the top of the screen on which bar / beat the selected object (or the playing music) is.

auto-guidelines.name: Automatic guidelines
auto-guidelines.description: The editor guidelines update by themselves after every timing change (adding, moving or deleting a timing point, analysis, .osu import). Replaces guidelines added by hand.

hide-buttons-playtest.name: Hide buttons while playtesting
hide-buttons-playtest.description: The BPM / WAVE / TIME / 1/N buttons disappear while you playtest the level in the editor.

buttons-layout.name: Editor buttons layout
buttons-layout.description: How the BPM / WAVE / TIME / 1/N buttons are arranged in the editor.

buttons-x.name: Editor buttons X
buttons-x.description: Moves the editor buttons left (negative) or right (positive).

buttons-y.name: Editor buttons Y
buttons-y.description: Moves the editor buttons down (negative) or up (positive).

auto-use-song.name: Use loaded song in the level
auto-use-song.description: When you load an audio file in the Timing window opened from a level, the level plays that file right away (local song ID).
